derivedFrom: software/_connector/versions/1.0.0 (the previous release of this resource)
releaseScope: Architecture 3.2, step P4a (credential path): the connector can now turn a declared `reference:<name>` into what a body needs without the value crossing argv, evidence, the call index or the artifact scan. No engine byte, no contract byte and no published recipe was touched; 1.0.0 stays byte-identical.
changes: credential materialization: a platform-declared provider command (config.credentialProvider) is asked over a pipe, the value is written to a mode-0600 file in config.credentialWorkspace, and the argv slots that reference the file come from the release’s own credentialInjection declaration - shared code names neither a credential store nor a client flag spelling (BP-2).
the injected slots go in front of everything the recipe asked for, because a MySQL-style option file is only read as the client’s first argument.

evidence carries the reference, the format, the file path and the count of injected slots; argv is redacted, and redaction replaces rather than hashes, since a digest of a short secret is a guessing oracle.
the credential workspace joins the artifact scan’s exclusion list: a list of what the software wrote must never be able to report the temporary credential file.
whatever happens after materialization - a refusal, a timeout, a body that could not start - the file is discarded in the same call, because the discard runs in the call’s own finally.
unchanged: the three published engine-facing shapes, the session shape and ai-software-admin/v1: same requests, same answers, still zero new error codes
resolution, attestation (snapshot-only, never --tools), locks, idempotency, sessions, artifacts
software/_connector/versions/1.0.0 and every published recipe: byte for byte
the five other recipes still carry no connector.json, so they still resolve through the derived overlay; only mysql-cli 1.0.2 declares one
openDeferred: D-87: the injection shape had no home in any published declaration, so credentialInjection was added to the still-unpublished ai-software-connector/v1 candidate (qoder runtime). Publishing it as contract is a repo-lint/contracts step, not a connector step.
the env injection format is implemented but has no fixture body that reads it; every release declared so far uses ini.

a real credential-requiring dispatch (mysql query/dump) is P4b: this release was exercised against a fake provider and a fake body, plus the platform’s real provider read-only without dispatching MySQL.

mysql-cli 1.0.2 is published but its pointer is not switched here: other platforms pin 1.0.1, and an in-flight 1.0.1 pin resolves to SOFTWARE_NOT_INSTALLED the moment the pointer moves - that is a cross-platform adoption decision, not a connector one.
pointerPolicy: software/_connector/current.json moves 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1: this resource was published the same day and no platform config points at it yet, so its own default carries no cross-platform reader. 1.0.0 stays immutable and readable.

selftest.also: the 3.2 P3 battery is rerun against this release (98 cells) so the credential work cannot silently regress the dispatch chain
